label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/xss): alert-TP — resolved sink value is param (user-controlled input from request.getParameter('BenchmarkTest')). Although there is a regex filter using getInitParameter('safe.pattern'), this is a deployment-time configuration gate, not runtime sanitization. The sink response.getWriter().println(param) outputs param directly without HTML encoding. An attacker could configure safe.pattern to '.*' or similar to bypass the filter entirely, leaving user-controlled data flowing to the response sink unescaped.

evidence.note: User input retrieved via request.getParameter('BenchmarkTest') assigned to param, then conditionally printed to response.getWriter() without HTML encoding
Regex filter uses deploy-time init parameter 'safe.pattern' — attacker can configure this to accept malicious payloads, making the filter unreliable
